title: Dagesh and Meteg
description: Dagesh marks either pronunciation or consonant doubling. Meteg provides another clue for reading a pointed word.

blocks.html: Dagesh qal occurs in a Begadkephat letter and often marks its stop pronunciation. Dagesh hazaq marks a doubled consonant and can appear in many other letters, though gutturals and resh resist doubling. Meteg is a short vertical mark beneath a letter and can support syllable or stress interpretation. Identify the letter class and syllable position before deciding what a dagesh means.

didYouKnow: According to OSHB/MorphHB (CC BY 4.0), the most frequent word in this unit is גָּדוֹל (gādôl), occurring 286 times in the Westminster Leningrad Codex.
